hooks.name: h7-trace-schema-check
hooks.description: H7: when a fixture trace file is added or modified, validate it against the GhostTrace schema. Runs after any save to fixtures/traces/.

action.prompt:
Hook H7 (trace-schema-check) fired: a .seance fixture trace was saved.

1. Read the saved file.
2. Import validateTrace from 'seance-core' and run it against the parsed JSON.
3. If valid, check: all channels have matching t.length and data.length; timestamps are monotonically increasing; data values are finite numbers.
4. Reply briefly with: validation result, channel summary, any warnings about data quality.
